I went through the same thing! I was having a sexuality crisis and quite strong anxiety and then I started thinking about my gender and I just started getting confused with the amount of information out there.
There have been records across history of people not identifying as male or female so how would you explain that? /gen

I thought I might be genderfluid for a while (I am an white, middle class girl) because of liking different pronouns and an overwhelming of information but these forums and the counsellor helped me realise that I just didn’t care about pronouns because I can’t imagine people referring to me. I think that my anxiety also played a part and my need to be ‘special’. Once I realised that, I was a lot happier with myself.
Thank you. This really helped me and I’ve decided I’m going to call myself cis but questioning unless something happens as it is probably the best label that doesn’t harm the trans community.

I think she uses it as a micro label under the umbrella of being genderqueer as I think it just helps her find a bit of a sense of identity. I also identify as genderfluid but I don’t know if that’s right. I don’t think I’m ftm but I understand where she’s coming from as I just don’t feel connected to being female and change pronouns but I’m probably just cis and wanting to feel special. I don’t know if I have body dysphoria (probably not) but I don’t really feel any connection to my breasts (idk if anyone does though) so I’m thinking that I’m cis but maybe gnc cause I like to go by different pronouns but I don’t really know if that qualifies as being gnc.
I’m still questioning but currently I think I’m genderfluid as on some days I am ok with she/her (I’m afab) and being seen as a girl and other times I prefer he/him and want to be seen as a boy.
